items.quote: There’s no such thing as perfect leads. No magical button that says: “Only the clients who are ready to invest today.”
items.statement: There’s no such thing as perfect leads.

items.quote: That’s why great sales isn’t about chasing warmer leads. It’s about asking better questions.
items.statement: Great sales isn’t about chasing warmer leads; it’s about asking better questions.

items.quote: You don’t wait for clarity to appear. You create it — by helping the client understand themselves through the conversation.
items.statement: You create clarity by helping the client understand themselves through the conversation.

items.quote: When you ask the right questions, → Their priorities rise to the surface → Their fears become visible → And your offer starts to feel like a reflection of their thinking.
items.statement: When you ask the right questions, priorities rise to the surface and fears become visible.

items.quote: So if your deals feel stuck — It might not be the market.
items.statement: Deals might feel stuck not because of the market but because of inadequate questioning.

items.quote: When was the last time a client said something they didn’t even realise they were thinking — because of the question you asked?
items.statement: Clients may express thoughts they didn’t realize they were having from good questioning.

overview: LinkedIn post discussing the nature of sales leads and client engagement in real estate.
